svg.data-psu-redundancy: dual-feed one power stage, fixed (not field-replaceable)
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO with optional holdover; ITU-T SyncE; IEEE 1588v2 default, G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2 (extra licence), T-GM, T-BC/OC, T-TC; Class C accuracy. NOS integration is required to activate the timing features
svg.data-gnss: internal receiver for master clock implementations
svg.data-timing-interfaces: GNSS in on SMA, 10MHz in/out on SMB, 1PPS in/out on SMB, ToD in/out on RJ45, BITS in on RJ48 (datasheet Timing Interfaces)
svg.data-combo-ports: ports 0-3 are 1G RJ45/SFP combo, configurable to either connection type; the faceplate presents both an RJ45 and an SFP aperture for each (HIG Port Overview)
svg.data-timing-cables: 50 ohm SMA coaxial with 1/4-36UNS-2B for GNSS; 50 ohm SMB coaxial with 10-32UNF-2A for 1PPS and 10MHz; shielded RJ45 for ToD; shielded RJ48 for BITS
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 300 386; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; EN 55035; EN 50663; EN 62479; BSMI

rect.data-members: port-0-rj45 port-1-rj45 port-2-rj45 port-3-rj45 port-0-sfp port-1-sfp port-2-sfp port-3-sfp

g.data-description: HIG section 8 Front Panel LED table, GNSS row - Off (not configured), Solid Green (normal, self-survey complete), Blinking Green (learning, self-survey not complete), Solid Yellow (power up, not tracking any satellite), Blinking Yellow (antenna short to ground)
g.title: led-gnss

g.data-description: HIG section 8 Front Panel LED table, SYNC row - Off (timing synchronization disabled or free-run), Solid Green (timing core synchronized to an external source), Blinking Green (synchronized in SyncE mode), Solid Yellow (acquiring or holdover), Blinking Yellow (synchronization fail)
g.title: led-sync

g.data-description: HIG section 8 Front Panel LED table, STAT row - Off (x86 and BMC initializing or not powered), Solid Green (boot complete), Blinking Green (system is booting)
g.title: led-stat

g.data-description: HIG section 8 Front Panel LED table, FAN row - Off (not powered), Solid Green (all fans work well), Blinking Yellow (one or more fans fail). The fans are FIXED, so this lamp names the chassis rather than four fan ids - see the fixed-fru-not-addressable gap
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG section 8 Front Panel LED table, PWR row - Off (no power or shutdown), Solid Green (system power good), Blinking Green (system power good but BMC power fail), Solid Yellow (system power good but CPU power fail), Blinking Yellow (system power fail)
g.title: led-pwr

g.data-description: led-mgmt-left: HIG section 8 Management port LED table, Left LED - Off (1G no link), Solid Green (1G link-up), Blinking Green (1G TX/RX activity); led-mgmt-right: HIG section 8 Management port LED table, Right LED - Off (no link), Solid Amber (10M/100M link-up), Blinking Amber (10M/100M TX/RX activity). The two lamps do not share a vocabulary, so they are declared separately
g.title: mgmt
